reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (North Carolina, 2021)
    Question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate
    prior to terminating a tenancy?

    Statutes encoded:
      [1] NC Gen Stat  42-3 (2021)  - forfeiture for nonpayment after demand + 10 days
      [2] NC Gen Stat  42-14 (2021) - notice to quit for certain periodic tenancies;
                                      special 60-day rule for manufactured home spaces
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (facts)
   ========================= */

scenario_state(north_carolina).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

/* Factual statement encoded for this question:
   - Landlord is terminating a tenancy (ordinary termination, not for nonpayment)
   - Tenancy is month-to-month
   - Tenancy does NOT involve only the rental of a space for a manufactured home
*/
scenario_landlord_terminating_tenancy(yes).
scenario_termination_reason(ordinary_termination).
scenario_tenancy_type(month_to_month).
scenario_manufactured_home_space_only(no).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds exactly when the scenario facts hold together. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(north_carolina),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord_terminating_tenancy(yes),
    scenario_termination_reason(ordinary_termination),
    scenario_tenancy_type(month_to_month),
    scenario_manufactured_home_space_only(no).

/* =========================
   Statute translations
   ========================= */

/* ---- [2] NC Gen Stat  42-14 (2021): Notice to quit in certain tenancies ----
   Encodes minimum notice periods (in days) required to terminate:
     - year-to-year: one month or more (modeled as >= 30 days)
     - month-to-month: 7 days
     - week-to-week: 2 days
   Provided, however:
     - if tenancy involves ONLY rental of a space for a manufactured home,
       notice to quit must be given at least 60 days before end of current rental period,
       regardless of term.
*/
statute_nc_42_14_notice_to_quit_required(TenancyType, ManufacturedHomeSpaceOnly, MinDaysNotice) :-
    ManufacturedHomeSpaceOnly == yes,
    MinDaysNotice = 60,
    valid_tenancy_type(TenancyType).
statute_nc_42_14_notice_to_quit_required(year_to_year, no, 30).
statute_nc_42_14_notice_to_quit_required(month_to_month, no, 7).
statute_nc_42_14_notice_to_quit_required(week_to_week, no, 2).

/* helper: tenancy types recognized in  42-14 */
valid_tenancy_type(year_to_year).
valid_tenancy_type(month_to_month).
valid_tenancy_type(week_to_week).

/* ---- [1] NC Gen Stat  42-3 (2021): Term forfeited for nonpayment of rent ----
   Rule summary:
     - In a lease with a definite time fixed for payment of rent:
       if (a) lessor makes a demand for all past-due rent, and
          (b) lessee fails to pay within 10 days after that demand,
       then forfeiture of the term is implied and lessor may enter/dispossess
       without having declared forfeiture or reserved right of reentry in the lease.

   This statute centers on demand + 10-day nonpayment (not a "notice to quit" requirement).
*/
statute_nc_42_3_forfeiture_for_nonpayment(DefiniteRentDueTimeFixed, DemandMade, DaysAfterDemand, RentPaidWithin10Days, ForfeitureImplied, LessorMayDispossessForthwith) :-
    ( DefiniteRentDueTimeFixed == yes,
      DemandMade == yes,
      number(DaysAfterDemand),
      DaysAfterDemand >= 10,
      RentPaidWithin10Days == no
    ->
      ForfeitureImplied = yes,
      LessorMayDispossessForthwith = yes
    ;
      ForfeitureImplied = no,
      LessorMayDispossessForthwith = no
    ).

/* =========================
   Legal reasoning helpers
   ========================= */

/* Determine whether NC law requires a "notice to quit" (notice to vacate)
   prior to terminating a tenancy under the scenario.
*/
nc_requires_notice_to_vacate_before_termination(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_termination_reason(ordinary_termination),
    scenario_tenancy_type(TenancyType),
    scenario_manufactured_home_space_only(MHOnly),
    statute_nc_42_14_notice_to_quit_required(TenancyType, MHOnly, MinDays),
    number(MinDays),
    MinDays > 0,
    !.
nc_requires_notice_to_vacate_before_termination(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ ( scenario_termination_reason(ordinary_termination),
         scenario_tenancy_type(TenancyType2),
         scenario_manufactured_home_space_only(MHOnly2),
         statute_nc_42_14_notice_to_quit_required(TenancyType2, MHOnly2, MinDays2),
         number(MinDays2),
         MinDays2 > 0
       ),
    !.

/* =========================
   Final answer
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    nc_requires_notice_to_vacate_before_termination(yes),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    nc_requires_notice_to_vacate_before_termination(no),
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate the property prior to terminating a tenancy?
